items.title: The normalization is idempotent: normalizing the normalization gives the same scheme
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that normalizing a base in a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism and then normalizing the result in the same source returns the same scheme (statement lines 14050-14055). The counted proof is short and complete: the universal property of the normalization applied to the composite of the second normalization with the first gives a canonical morphism in the reverse direction, and uniqueness of the factorization shows that it is inverse to the structure morphism of the second normalization (proof lines 14057-14064). It is H2: the two steps are carried out in the counted span, with the cited input being the characterization of the normalization by its universal property.
